title: The Conditional Loop (WHILE)
objectives: Know when to use a WHILE loop
Understand how a pre-test loop works

hook.text: "Ask again until the user enters the right password." Here you do NOT know in advance how many rounds it will take. A counting loop (FOR) will not work here.

concept.heading: When is WHILE used?
concept.body: A FOR loop is used when you know the number of rounds IN ADVANCE ("from 1 to 10"). A WHILE loop is used when the number of rounds is not known and you just want to keep going as long as a CONDITION is true.

items.label: WHILE (conditional)
items.sub: as long as the condition is true

concept.heading: Pre-test behavior
concept.body: The structure WHILE condition ... END_LOOP checks the condition BEFORE every round. If the condition is FALSE right from the start, the loop body does not run even once. That is what "pre-test" means.

workedExamples.prompt: Starting at 1 and going up by 2, print numbers until you pass 10.
workedExamples.runnerSource:
number ← 1
WHILE number ≤ 10
  WRITE number
  number ← number + 2
END_LOOP

steps.explain: 1 is put into the number box.
1 ≤ 10 is TRUE, so the loop is entered.

exercises.question: What does this code write to the screen?
exercises.hint: i starts at 0 and continues as long as it is less than 4.

exercises.question: What happens if the WHILE condition is FALSE at the very start of the program?
options: The loop body does not run even once

feedback.correct: Correct. If the condition is FALSE right from the start, a pre-test loop never enters its body.
feedback.incorrect: WHILE checks the condition BEFORE every round; if it is FALSE from the start, the body never runs.

exercises.question: Which loop is better suited to a problem where you do not know in advance how many times it will repeat?

feedback.correct: Correct. When the number of rounds is not known, a WHILE (condition-based) loop is used.
feedback.incorrect: When the number of rounds is unknown, a WHILE loop is used, which depends only on a condition.

exercises.question: Put the steps of the algorithm that keeps asking the user until they enter the right password in the correct order.

exercises.hint: In each round, total is updated first, then counter goes up by 1.

exercises.question: Complete the sentence.
exercises.template: A WHILE loop checks the condition ___ every round.

summary: FOR: when the number of rounds is known. WHILE: when it depends only on a condition.
WHILE checks the condition BEFORE every round (pre-test).
If the condition is FALSE from the start, the WHILE body never runs.
